1.title: Plan Your Routine
1.description: Organize your tasks into ongoing Habits, recurring Dailies, and one-off To-Dos with checklists and deadlines.

2.title: Execute with Focus & Consistency
2.description: Complete real tasks. The mathematical engine scores your consistency, granting XP and Coins (🪙) in Adventure Mode or Points (pts) and Credits in Essential Mode.

3.title: Reward Your Dedication
3.description: Set up your own rewards in the Store: breaks, leisure, free-time blocks, or lucky Mystery Boxes (in Adventure Mode).

4.title: Enjoy Guilt-Free
4.description: Access your Inventory/Backpack, enjoy your earned rest with peace of mind, and keep your discipline sustainable.
